$comment: Read by scripts/check-institution-links.mjs. This file is DATA, on purpose: the checker contains no branch that names a host, a university or a country. Anything that needs special handling is an entry here with a reason beside it, so the next person can disagree with the reason rather than read the code.

Cloudflare interstitial on every path including the root — 403 with a "Just a moment..." body to the verifier, to a plain fetch and to a scripted browser. The University of Barcelona moved its whole English site here, so no UB page can be read by this project at all. Nothing on this host is recorded as read directly, so UB's links stay unknowable rather than excused; see the note on the Universitat de Barcelona record.

UB's old host, which now redirects every path to web.ub.edu and inherits its Cloudflare wall. Listed separately because the verifier looks the host up on the URL it was asked for, not on the one it was sent to.

Imperva challenge on the admissions pages; the Singapore research pass could not read them either and recorded that as our gap rather than SMU’s.

Cloudflare bot verification. Refuses WebFetch, and does not clear in the agent browser pane either — it sits on "Performing security verification" indefinitely. It DOES serve normally to a signed-in human browser, which is how the transcript deadlines were established on 2026-09-23. So the entry means "no automated pass can read this", not "nobody can": when ibo.org is the only source for something, it needs a person with a browser. Completing the challenge is not something this project does.
IB Answers. Served "We are down for maintenance" on 2026-09-23. Recorded so the next pass does not read a maintenance page as an answer.

The IB Recognition Statements Database — 140+ countries and 2,000+ universities, plus credit and advanced-standing policies for about 800 US institutions. A JavaScript application that serves no readable text to a fetch. It is the best primary source for what a Destination says about the IB, so it is worth a person’s time rather than an agent’s. Relevant to #15.

$comment2: The checker reads only the two keys above. The list below is a record, not an input: it is here because the reason for leaving a redirect alone is exactly the kind of judgement this file exists to hold, and because otherwise the next pass re-investigates the same nine links.

redirectsLeftAtTheOldUrl.reason: Each of these resolves to its CMS's internal entry file — intro_221212.html, index.do, a jsessionid, main.html. The destination is an artefact of the software rather than an address the university publishes, and it will change the next time the CMS does. The clean URL recorded is the one the university advertises and the one that will still work. Followed and read 2026-09-23.
Redirects to www4.uib.no/en, a numbered host that reads as a migration staging name rather than a permanent home. Bergen advertises www.uib.no. Followed and read 2026-09-23.

Redirects one level down to its own requirements/ sub-page, which is already recorded as CUHK's ibPageUrl. Following it would make the admissions link and the IB link the same address and lose the distinction. Followed and read 2026-09-23.
